title: Coded identity development
summary: Development of the identity from the original commission into an SOS / SaveOurS Morse-code construction containing an actual barcode.

lensAssignments.rationale: The responsibility centres on meaning, recognition, identity, visual language or the designed human experience.
The coded mark is defined as a repeatable visual system combining SOS in Morse code with a barcode construction.
lensAssignments.lensSummary: System and product-definition responsibility: Development of a repeatable coded identity combining an SOS / SaveOurS Morse-code construction with an actual barcode.
